qualityCommitment.title: Our Quality Commitment
qualityCommitment.intro: DELIVERY Digital Nice strives to provide training services that meet the needs and requirements of its customers. However, if you wish to submit a complaint to us:
qualityCommitment.contact: You can, at any time, address your questions, doubts, and problems encountered to your usual contacts, who will do everything possible to provide you with an answer.
qualityCommitment.formOption: You also have the option of sending your request using the complaint form below.

steps.1: You fill out the form which is automatically sent to the team responsible for processing complaints
steps.2: We acknowledge receipt of your complaint
steps.3: We analyze your request as quickly as possible and assess its admissibility
steps.4: If your request is admissible, we analyze the causes of the complaint
steps.5: We carefully examine the facts presented and carry out, if necessary, the necessary research. In this case, we keep you informed of the progress of the case
steps.6: We will inform you of our response, specifying the results of our investigation and any solutions we propose to resolve the problem

qualityCommitment.directContact: To contact the complaints handling team directly:
